questions.instructions:
Correct or Incorrect | Q7
1 of 2 points

sentences.ar: مكث الضيوفُ عندنا ثلاثةُ أيّامٍ ما قَصَّرنا في إكرامِه
sentences.en: The guests stayed by us for 3 days whilst we did not lack in honouring them (with good hospitality).

parts.label: a
parts.ask: Is the sentence correct or incorrect?

parts.label: c
parts.ask: Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them. If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".
parts.answer: The word ثلاثة should have a fathah as it is zarf (time/place). The مضاف إليه of إكرام should be plural, هم, as it is referring to the guests who are plural.
parts.feedback:
The word ثلاثة should have a fathah as it is zarf (time/place).
The مضاف إليه of إكرام should be plural, هم, as it is referring to the guests who are plural.

sentences.ar: سمعتُ (ثابتًا) مِن كلام بكرٍ مَا حَدَثَ بِزيدٍ دارسٍ
sentences.en: I heard, whilst it being from the statement of Bakr, that which (what) happened to Zaid whilst studying.

parts.label: a
parts.ask: Is the sentence correct or incorrect?

parts.label: c

parts.answer: The word دارس should be دارسا, it should be mansoob because it is the haal of Zaid.

questions.instructions:
Correct or Incorrect | Q9
1 of 2 points

sentences.ar: أكل زيدٌ هو شبعانِ ثُمَّ تَأَلَّمَ بطنُها
sentences.en: Zaid ate whilst he was satiated then his stomach ached.

parts.label: a
parts.ask: Is the sentence correct or incorrect?

parts.label: c
parts.ask: Explain the mistakes and how to rectify them. If there are no mistakes, then write: "No mistakes".
parts.answer: There should be a waaw haaliyyah before 'هو' because the haal 'هو شبعان' is a jumlah ismiyyah which begins with the dhameer raabit. Also, شبعانٍ should be شبعانُ as it is مرفوع because of being the خبر of هو and it's also غير منصرف hence no tanween. Also, it should be 'بطنه' because it is referring to the stomach of zaid and he is male (hopefully).
parts.my_response: shhould be "wa ho wa". and shob3aan should be marfoo3
parts.feedback:
There should be a waaw haaliyyah before 'هو' because the haal 'هو شبعان' is a jumlah ismiyyah which begins with the dhameer raabit.
Also, شبعانٍ should be شبعانُ as it is مرفوع because of being the خبر of هو and it's also غير منصرف hence no tanween.
Also, it should be 'بطنه' because it is referring to the stomach of zaid and he is male (hopefully).
